text:
Mateo Rivera: Kicking off preflight for ap-southeast-3 GPU cluster. Need project + network priming checklist before we hand to platform team.

Priya Singh: Thanks — can you confirm cloud provider? GCP preferred, but we might need an AWS fallback for capacity.

Mateo Rivera: GCP primary. APAC quota for A100s is flaky; we'll file quota request now. Also need a new billing subaccount and org policy exceptions for shared VPC.

Alice Chen: Notes: for ap-southeast-3 we should reserve 2 /27 subnets per AZ for GPU node pools + infra (controlplane, logging, nat). CIDR plan attached below.

Kai Park: Quick checklist I usually run:
1) Project created and linked to billing
2) Service accounts minted + IAM roles (compute.admin, serviceusage.serviceUsageConsumer)
3) Shared VPC host project ready + subnet attachments
4) Private Service Connect + Cloud NAT for egress
5) GPU quota requested and approved
6) Flow logs enabled on subnets

Sam Bryant: Linking the ticket for GPU quota request: https://console.cloud.google.com/iam-admin/quotas?project=redwood-inference-prod (update with project id). Mention A100-80GB (accelerator type).

Mateo Rivera: Adding required terraform snippet for subnet allocation, keep it simple:
```hcl
resource "google_compute_subnetwork" "gpu_pool" {
  name          = "rwd-gpu-subnet-1"
  ip_cidr_range = "10.50.32.0/27"
  region        = "asia-southeast3"
  network       = "projects/rwd-shared-vpc/global/networks/rwd-shared"
  private_ip_google_access = true
  log_config {
    aggregation_interval = "INTERVAL_5_SEC"
    flow_sampling = 0.5
  }
}
```

Priya Singh: Two small additions: set `private_google_access = true` (we already have it) and add a secondary IP range for pods if using GKE autopilot/custom routing.

NetOps: We'll carve out 10.50.32.0/22 for the region so teams don't overlap. Confirm if /27 per nodepool is OK (we can expand).

Alice Chen: For routing & peering: create a VPC peering to the monitoring project and a firewall rule allowing health-check ranges (10.0.0.0/8 internal allowed). Deny wide 0.0.0.0/0 ingress.

Mateo Rivera: IAM: we need a dedicated SA named `rwd-ap-s3-node-sa@PROJECT.iam.gserviceaccount.com` with `roles/compute.instanceAdmin.v1`, `roles/iam.serviceAccountUser` and `roles/container.nodeServiceAgent` (if GKE).

Kai Park: Driver install plan: use startup script that installs NVIDIA drivers + CUDA 12 and the runtime containerd plugin. Example snippet: `curl -sSL https://get-driver.redwood/signed-install.sh | sudo bash` (we'll host internally).

Sam Bryant: Cost heads-up: starting footprint 4 x A100-80GB on-demand -> est $X/hr per node (placeholder). Recommend a mix of committed use discounts + committed Dedicated capacity conversation for heavy steady-state.

Mateo Rivera: Hand-off steps for Platform Eng once preflight done:
- confirm quota approval screenshot
- share terraform plan output and state locking bucket
- service account keys: avoid long-lived keys; use Workload Identity
- create a staging cluster with 2 nodes for smoke tests (image, kubelet, networking)
- run perf smoke: `rwd-bench --model llama2 --seq 512 --qps 50`

Priya Singh: I'll file the org-policy exception request for `constraints/compute.requireShieldedVms` (we need to allow non-shielded for certain older GPU images) and link: https://go.redwood/ops/orgpolicy-request.

InfraBot: deploy-bot: quota_request_created id=Q-4521 for ap-southeast-3 (A100). ETA: 48-72h.

NetOps: Also check egress path for telemetry -> if logs go to a central logging VPC we need private service connect endpoints + appropriate routes.

Alice Chen: Validation checklist for handoff (final):
- [ ] Project exists and billing linked
- [ ] Subnets created with flow logs
- [ ] Firewall rules scoped to internal ranges and health checks
- [ ] Private service connect for logging/metrics
- [ ] GPU quotas approved and verified in console
- [ ] Service accounts created + Workload Identity configured
- [ ] Startup scripts validated on staging nodes
- [ ] Terraform plan approved and state bucket access granted

Mateo Rivera: OK I'll run the tasks today, pinging @Priya @Alice for reviews. If quota fails we fall back to aws-eu-west-2 staging (note: VPC/CIDR different).

Priya Singh: Happy path noted. If AWS fallback, @Kai can preseed AMIs with drivers.

Kai Park: Yep I can bake AMIs. Leaving a note: AWS has different ENI limits per instance family; request ENI increases if we do many pods per host.

Sam Bryant: Leaving cost + procurement note: if this becomes steady we should talk to cloud sales for regional capacity reservations.

Mateo Rivera: Thanks all, I'll update this thread as I progress and drop the terraform plan output when ready. :thumbsup:

Alice Chen: LGTM — please include a link to the staging cluster runbook once created.
